name: 35216 · Vestavia Hls, AL
findings: ZIP 35216 (Vestavia Hls) has 224 nonprofit organizations. 95 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 74 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35216 (Vestavia Hls) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
